{{Quote|Take Chack aft and work your way forward. Let him take his time. Tag anything that gets his attention, and we’ll deal with it separately.|Unidentified female chief inspector|<ref name="CoD" />}}
'''Chack''' was the name of a saurian quadruped who sniffed out contraband for the [[Eriadu Customs and Immigration]] security forces. This animal was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Arwen Cohl]]'s hired [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] shortly before the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt on [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] at the [[Eriadu Trade Summit]].<ref name="CoD" />
